prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: wrist fracture. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1018; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a low-speed collision in a retail parking lot. Insured reports rear bumper contact while reversing. Claimant vehicle reported with rear quarter panel damage. Claimant reports wrist injury at scene and was transported to urgent care. Police report not filed; scene photos requested from insured.

Entry 2: Claimant has retained counsel. Representation letter received requesting all further communication go through the attorney's office. Direct contact with claimant suspended. Liability appears probable based on insured's statement and witness account of the reversing vehicle. Preliminary file review completed.

Entry 3: Attorney's office provided medical records indicating a fracture of the wrist with a cast applied and follow-up with an orthopedic specialist scheduled. Treatment is ongoing. Bodily injury reserve set pending receipt of full treatment timeline and billing. Requested an independent medical review to confirm the extent of the fracture and expected recovery period.

Entry 4: Vehicle inspection completed by a field appraiser. Rear bumper replacement, quarter panel repair, and taillight assembly replacement recommended. Repair estimate received from the body shop and reviewed. Attorney's office notified that the property damage portion of the claim is being processed separately from the bodily injury claim.

Entry 5: Demand package received from claimant's counsel including medical bills, wage loss documentation, and a narrative of the claimed injury impact. Demand is under review against medical records and liability assessment. Scheduled a negotiation call with counsel and noted that the file requires supervisor sign-off before any offer is extended.
